acceptanceCriteria: Leadership reconciliation後のLEADERLESS / FRAGMENTED候補はRisk Opportunityと同一のcanonical risk presentation reasonを表示し、zh-CN/en-US/ja-JPで旧StrengthLoss語彙をCandidate/Watchlist ViewModel・Markdown・Telegram HTML・Archive Markdownへ漏らさない。
RECOVERY_WATCHがあるStrengthLoss候補は三言語で既存canonical recovery wordingを維持し、通常のleader-confirmed StrengthLoss raw wordingは本修正だけを理由に置換しない。
Candidate表示はcanonical risk ViewModelだけを参照し、同一のcandidate labelを重複表示しない。canonical risk factが欠落した場合はraw reasonを表示しない。
positionなし・eligible=falseの巡航候補は三言語で既存のobservation-only wordingを使い、「持有为主」等の実行含意がある表現を使わない。

既存Risk Summary / Portfolio Risk / Top Actions canonical表示を保持する。Decision、Gate、Probe、Eligibility、Action Matrix、Risk Adjustment、Exit State、Position Sizing、decision_weight=0 / trade_signal=falseの出力意味を変更しない。
production-like回帰がPresentationAssemblerからgenerate_refined_reportまでを通り、Markdown・Telegram HTML・Archive Markdownすべてで同じcanonical意味を検証する。

executionDecision.reason: ユーザーが候補 canonical risk reason の回帰修正を依頼し、対象・除外範囲・受け入れ条件・検証方法を提示した。実装は presentation boundary に限定でき、指定テストで局所検証可能。

goal: 最終LeadershipがLEADERLESS / FRAGMENTEDと確定したとき、Candidate/Watchlist診断が同じPresentationPacket内のcanonical risk presentation reasonを使うようにし、未保有かつ候補対象外の巡航説明を既存の観測文言に揃える。Decision/Gate/Eligibility/Execution/Position Sizingの意味は変えない。
intent: 候補/Watchlist表示におけるraw StrengthLoss理由の漏出を修正する
outOfScope: Decision、Gate、NO TRADE/Probe/Ready、Probe budget、Eligibility calculation、Action Matrix、Risk Adjustment calculation、Exit State calculation、RS、Leadership calculation、Breakout、Breadth、Execution、Trader、Position Sizing、Supply、Gravity、Expectation、TemporalBinding、Signal Context ranking、threshold、candidate selection、domain risk calculation、i18n辞書の新設、production data/report artifact、Archiveの既存履歴、CI/Make入口の改変。
preReviewWarnings: Leaderless の最終確定は初期 PresentationAssembler の後段で行われるため、候補診断と risk summary の再構成タイミングを同時に確認する。
Risk reason の修正は Candidate 表示だけに適用し、confirmed leader の raw StrengthLoss 文言と Decision / Gate / Probe 出力を維持する。

scenarioCoverage.expected: Candidate risk reason equals same-symbol canonical Risk Opportunity wording in zh-CN/en-US/ja-JP; old StrengthLoss wording is absent from ViewModel, Markdown, Telegram HTML and archival Markdown.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: report_ui regression exercises PresentationAssembler, final Leadership reconciliation and generate_refined_report across all three localized surfaces.

scenarioCoverage.expected: StrengthLoss plus RECOVERY_WATCH retains existing localized canonical recovery wording on Candidate and risk presentation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: production-like report_ui regression checks canonical recovery wording and absence of legacy raw phrase in the ViewModel and each report surface.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Candidate diagnostic is omitted or neutral and never falls back to raw StrengthLoss reason when a valid same-symbol canonical risk fact is unavailable.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: report_ui regression invokes leaderless reconciliation with missing and malformed matching risk facts and checks the candidate consumer.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A confirmed leader remains eligible to use the existing raw StrengthLoss wording; the leaderless presentation fix does not blanket-rewrite it.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: localized report_ui control case starts with confirmed Leadership and checks existing reason semantics.

scenarioCoverage.expected: With no position and candidate eligibility false, READY/Probe candidate explanation uses the existing observation-only wording in all three languages and never says hold-first.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: report_ui regression renders the assembled candidate and checks localized Markdown, Telegram HTML and archival Markdown outputs.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Candidate label appears once and remains separate from risk reason; Decision/Gate/Probe/Eligibility/Action Matrix/Risk Adjustment/Exit State/Position Sizing outputs are unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: report output assertions check a single candidate label and compare decision-facing fields before and after presentation reconciliation.

scope: 変更対象は src/features/radar/interface/presentation_assembler.rs（最終Leadership反映時に候補診断をcanonical risk ViewModelへ同期し、未保有かつ候補対象外の汎用巡航診断を既存の観測文言へ揃える）、src/features/radar/interface/report.rs（Candidate表示内で同一のcandidate labelを二重表示しない）、src/features/radar/interface/report_ui_tests.rs（Assembler→Leadership reconciliation→generate_refined_report→Markdown/Telegram HTML/archiveのproduction-like回帰）、docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-26-risk-candidate-canonical-reason-regression.md（本WIの実装計画）。
